$comment: Manual review of every signature candidate (read in source, 2026-11-12). Keys are module ids (sha1 of repo:path, first 8 hex), never paths. `rejected`: not a visualization module, with a generic reason. `confirmed`: classified by the module's most demanding visualization; `forms` is the closed list fixed after the first pass. Rules: docs/v3/spikes/viz-census.md, Method.

search palette list, not a data mark

PIN entry dots and keypad (input UI, not a data reading)
fullscreen image viewer with thumbnail strip (layout mechanics)
map host component that mounts the engine map and measures frame timings; the map layer is drawn elsewhere
log line list with a severity dot per row (text list, not a visualization)
dev benchmark script
place search combobox with a result list (input UI)
plain list of records with a colour dot per row; no data-mapped mark
transient countdown timer (progress ring and phase bar) that is UI feedback, not a data reading
layout mechanics (virtual list)
static diagram: decision-tree layout with connector lines, positions do not encode data values
transient operation progress bar (UI feedback for a write run), not a data reading
photo editor canvas stage with crop frame

WebGL photo renderer
forecast tab shell: text readout grid with legend swatches; charts live in other modules

transient reindex operation progress bar; rest is stat cards and text
vendored minified cache file of a third-party library
spike: WebGL photo renderer
context menu with rating and label pickers (menu UI)
single progress bar for a batch job (transient operation progress) plus stat tiles and text

confirmed.note: CSS-variable-driven fill and average tick per row with a signed delta caption; partial month switches the caption wording only.
Five-slot filled/empty pips for a 1-5 rating on grid cards, same shape as another list module; the rest is a card grid with image tiles.

Third-party progress bars on an admin job monitor: one overall bar plus labelled per-category and coverage meters with 'x / y' captions; the rest is stat tiles and a table. Borderline against operation progress.
Weekly stacked bars by group with the running week drawn lighter through a per-datum opacity.
Absent cells are flat neutral with a tooltip; own cell binning by local day and hour; fixed absolute intensity domain.
Terrain silhouette, brightness-field cells, three body tracks and a gate line on custom marks, with a scrub slider driving a readout row.
Third-party progress bar per card showing done share of a count, with an 'x of n' caption; one hue.
Per-account share-left lines with dash cues, a now rule and per-line reset ticks on the baseline; legend turned off and no direct labels.
Segmented single-bar split with a tick marking the limit, overspend runs past it; also a ranked bar list and a data table.
Monthly bars in one card; also a ranked bar list in the other card.
Strip cells holding a goal-progress meter, a no-goal range marker meter, a zoned rate meter, and per-site sparklines with latest point emphasised and delta badges.
Daily minutes stacked by activity type with many categorical hues and a custom tooltip listing sessions.
A small terrain profile sparkline inside a drawer, next to rows of values with delta badges against a compared site.
Upcoming charges as a ranked list inside a card with a total and count fact.

Four stacked cartesian rows on a shared cursor: model lines, run-split percentile band, palette-coloured segments, bars with whiskers and rotated arrows thinned by plot width; categorical hues identify models.
Genre counts as a ranked bar list beside a non-visual list of items.
Three latency lines (one solid, two dashed) over a fixed window domain in a card without facts.
Weekly bars with the running week in an accent hue and a labelled dashed target line; tabs switch to daily bars with a mean line and a pace line chart.
Single-series count histogram over distance buckets with a hand-stepped label stride that always keeps the overflow bucket label; headline fact above.
Views-over-time bar chart with extra tooltip rows; also holds hand-built share meter rows and a segmented part-to-whole bar with a count legend.
Row of stat cards each with a bar sparkline and a delta against the previous equal-length period.

Recorded, projected and even-pace lines with a now rule and dot, labelled jumps and a run-out marker; label placement and thinning decided by app code from plot width (collision helper lives in a sibling module).
Also a multi-series total/split line chart and a single-series history line chart; per-account stack uses many categorical hues; hand-picked first/middle/last ticks on the history chart.
Ratio lines per category over four status zones with threshold lines and a labelled parity line; categories take distinct hues.
Interactive map with a data-coloured raster overlay, site markers with collision-placed names, a time scrubber, and legends including a gradient ramp rebuilt from a remapped window.
Scored factors as bars with a trailing share caption.
Also holds forecast lines with dashed projections, stat-strip sparklines (line and bar) and a single-value meter; per-category shaded bands are the reason for the CartesianChart verdict.
Per-item progress meter on a card with a facts line.
Ranked bar list in a card with a facts row; also a single-value meter against a limit in a stat strip.
Stacked and grouped bars over time in chart cards, plus stat cards with delta and bar sparkline; the calendar heat grid is a separate module.
One selectable cell per night with a computed bar fill and a tick, a best-night marker, scroll-snap and an off-screen count.
One zoned meter per row with a target band highlighted and a status word with distance from the band beneath.
Two-series stacked daily bars from a third-party chart library with mouse-only tooltip and click selection that fades bars.
Two ranked bar lists in cards, one with a facts row.
Single neutral series with a dashed target reference line.
Lines with optional area, dashed reference, crosshair and dots; exposes an active-index callback so a headline figure beside it can follow.
Small categorical grid of verdict text cells tinted by state with a count badge and an outlined current cell; cells carry words, not a value ramp.
Flex segments sized by value on one shared scale plus a swatch legend; colours are supplied by callers; equivalent to a segmented meter.
Strip of cells: hand-built bar histogram with a mean tick placed by a computed offset, plus a segmented shelf meter and a small bars chart from the kit.
Stat strip with seven day ticks (done, rest, upcoming, today), a target meter with a target tick and headroom, a sparkline and signed deltas against the prior period.
Stat cells each with a headline value, a signed delta against the previous period and a small bar or line sparkline; a tone rail marks the problem cell.
Two run series with labelled dashed reference lines for capacity limits, one-point-per-run.
Per-row sparkline inside a data table column, last point emphasised; the table also shows a signed delta against a typical value.
Strip cells with sparkline rows (latest point emphasised, focus readout labels, delta badges), a zoned ratio meter, a score meter and thin ranked bar lists.
Stacked weekly bars with per-datum opacity, a dashed average line overlay and labelled landmark threshold lines.
Three altitude tracks with dark-period bands, a highlighted window zone and a gate reference line; chart is paired with another sharing the cursor.
Five-slot filled/empty pips for a 1-5 rating on list rows; neutral colours, empty slots visible. Rest of the module is a list.
Single-series count histograms in chart cards; also a part-to-whole donut, a ranked bar list built on third-party progress bars, and stat cards.
Percent change per category from a window-start baseline drawn as a dashed zero line; header shows the leader's signed change.
Two lines with a hard-stop zone gradient area under the first, dashed boundary lines and legend-labelled zones.
Canvas strip painted from the shader lookup table with ticks placed through the same non-linear transfer; also palette swatch chips and a small svg glyph key.
Line and area with gaps, dashed projected tail, dashed target line or range band, crosshair and a latest-point dot.
CSS grid of day cells with log-scaled single-hue intensity, month labels placed on first columns and skipped on collision; native title tooltip only.
Two ranked bar lists with secondary text per row, plus a stacked share bar and legend from a shared hand-built component.
Three layered series on a shared time axis, paired with a second chart sharing the cursor.
Two stacked daily bar charts (one with neutral greys for expected causes and status hues for the problem) plus two ranked bar lists.
Ranked bar lists plus selectable rows with a thin stacked split bar (shared hand-built component) and a legend; cards carry a headline fact.
Labelled 0-1 factor meter rows with a dashed empty track for missing values and the weight printed beside; also a large score headline and verdict-coloured chips.
Signed stacked bars per group with a net line overlay, zero reference line, inside a card with a facts row.
Three standardised-score lines clamped to a fixed range, a normal band and a labelled zero baseline; header shows latest signed score per line; custom tooltip rows.
Weight line with point markers, a dashed rolling-mean overlay and an optional goal reference line; own padded y domain.
Tiny bar series with one accent bar, rounded data ends and a per-bar tooltip through a shared chart frame.
Median line with percentile band, max envelope, loss-coloured dots, rect rails for unmeasured, fully-down and outage spans, optional overlay line.
Small cartesian charts with night/day zones, reference lines, a dual axis, uncertainty bands, stepped-run line segmentation and rotated direction ticks coloured by state.
Instant ticks positioned along a day axis with the next item and a now mark highlighted; position fractions come from another module.
Trend lines over a signed rate histogram with positive and negative hues; header shows the latest rate with a direction arrow.

Cumulative lines with a shaded future-days zone, dashed projection and income reference line; also a segmented forecast meter, ranked bar list, bars with a highlighted month and a ranked bar list with average ticks.
Weekday by hour counts as one-hue heat cells with a legend and a busiest-cell fact; timezone shift done in a sibling module.
Four-state bands with a loss intensity ramp and a hand-written fold that merges adjacent buckets taking the worst value.
Four stage series, one plotted below zero, with a target band; categorical stage hues.
Monthly bars for one tag, plus a ranked bar list of tag sums; the rest is a work queue.
Monthly bars with a dashed average reference line; also a ranked bar list and per-row bar sparklines inside a table.
Stat strip cells with a sparkline against a dashed record reference and a signed period delta; also two zoned meters for readiness-style scores.
Two panes mirrored around a baseline with independent scales, partial buckets dimmed, absent share painted, hand-written fold.
Small line and bar sparklines with the latest value as text, inside table rows; last point emphasised.
Stacked area per category plus a multi-series line chart in a sibling card, one with a signed since-baseline delta in its facts.
Stacked segments per bar with gaps, categorical series colours, a legend row with per-series totals; hidden data table.
Two part-to-whole segmented meters in neutral shades stepping by rank.
Three grouped bar series per month; the peak month is stated only in the card header.
Rows with a duration bar scaled to the longest, failed step in the problem colour with its detail line; essentially a bar list in sequence order.
Ratio line over coloured zone bands and thresholds, stacked above a thin signed-bars strip on a shared x domain.
Per-point markers coloured by zone, a moving-average line, zone fills and threshold lines; header shows the latest value with its zone.
Single neutral line over three labelled verdict zones with a zone row in the tooltip.
Strip of five readings; four use a kit meter against a target, the ramp track is hand-built from gradient stops (a zoned meter approximates it).
Draggable scrubber rail: percent-positioned band, ticks whose stride comes from a measured label width, a now line and a thumb. A scrubber more than a chart, so the v3 mapping is a judgement call.
Single thin ranked list of spend by producer; the sibling card is text only.
Per-site lines with point markers plus a dashed average line; own padded y domain.
Cards are placed on a time axis from now by computed position and lane, with a break cell for items past the horizon and a hidden table; HTML cards, not drawn marks.
Three ranked bar lists (one with a fixed 0-100 max) plus a stacked share bar with legend from a shared hand-built component; status text callouts under the lists.
Expandable ranked rows, each with a split segmented meter, a period-change badge and a bar sparkline; the open row shows daily stacked bars by group.
Positive and negative bars on one axis with a net line overlay; sign carried by both side and hue.
One meter per day against a target tick (warn tone when over) plus a segmented two-part split meter; the rest of the file is list rows and skeletons.
Cell value is percent below the best hour; failed and absent cells have their own states; hand-written hourly binning and cell merge.
Rows with a thin share-of-total bar each and counts as text; expired rows dim.
One line per category with a dashed average each and enlarged markers on record points; categories take distinct hues.
Strip cells with a score meter plus trend sparkline (latest emphasised) and a zoned ratio meter; the day axis comes from another module.
Neutral daily and smoothed lines over three score zones with threshold lines; tooltip carries the zone and its drivers.
Two side-by-side single-series bar charts (hour of day, weekday) in one card with a busiest-slot fact.

Log-x scatter on engine marks with joined ladders, a frontier line, a quadrant band, ring glyphs drawn from pixel offsets, persistent collision-placed labels and a hand-positioned tooltip with pointer nearest-point tracking.
Stacked series by group with the running bucket shaded as partial; legend names the series; categorical palette.
Band strip with intensity by value, transition markers and a hand-written state fold; a headline sentence sits above it.
